_comment: DRAFT (F6, 2026-10-03). Format v2: every ruleset this policy owns, org- and repo-scoped, in one file (GOV-0033 d4). Nothing here has been applied.

organization_rulesets[] are POST/PUT bodies for /orgs/BloclabsHQ/rulesets. repository_rulesets[] are bodies for /repos/BloclabsHQ/<_repository>/rulesets. Upsert by name. Keys starting with '_' are stripped before apply.
Entries with _founder_decision are skipped by apply until that decision is recorded yes. _apply_after names the README 'Apply order' step that must be done first.
OrganizationAdmin actor_id 1 is the org-admin role (the API ignores actor_id for that type). Integration 5170152 = fabricbloc-agent-ops. 15368 = GitHub Actions app id.
Undeclared live rulesets are drift (cursor-env drift_check). Apply never deletes a ruleset that has no file.

policy_repo._note: Public source: a public workflow may run on any repository in the org, so no Actions 'Access' setting is needed.

pins._note: Every workflows-rule sha must equal one of these. Re-pinning = human PR to this file + org-owner apply. A push to policy-repo main alone changes nothing that runs. hygiene_sha is the L3 pin for hygiene reusable workflows on this commit.

organization_rulesets.name: canon-agent-gates
organization_rulesets._finding: F6 (PR #1526) layer (a): independent enforcement boundary for agent-denied-paths and agent-review-of-record.
organization_rulesets._apply_after: README step 4 with conditions.ref_name.include = _bootstrap_ref_include; step 5 switches to ~DEFAULT_BRANCH after the malicious test
organization_rulesets._bypass_note: Empty on purpose (decision F6-D2). No standing bypass on canon-agent-gates: break-glass is an org owner sets enforcement to Disabled (org audit log); fabricbloc cursor-env drift opens an issue while disabled. The gates pass at once for GOV-0022 human PRs to main, so nobody needs a bypass. An OrganizationAdmin bypass would also exempt Cursor whenever it acts with an admin's user token.

organization_rulesets.name: canon-branch-name-guard-pinned
organization_rulesets._comment: Optional: the same F6 fix for GOV-0022 'guard / guard', which today runs through fabricbloc's own (PR-editable) thin caller pinned to a0139c0. After apply, drop 'guard / guard' from main-required-ci.

repository_rulesets.name: main-required-ci
repository_rulesets._comment: Replaces the hand-made live ruleset of the same name. F6 change vs the cursor-env draft: agent-denied-paths and agent-review-of-record are REMOVED from required_status_checks (now 9 contexts). They are enforced by canon-agent-gates, because a context check is satisfied by ANY Actions job with that name, including one the PR adds.
repository_rulesets._apply_after: README step 6 (only once canon-agent-gates is live on ~DEFAULT_BRANCH)

repository_rulesets.name: canon-branch-creation-restricted
repository_rulesets._finding: Finding (c) layer B. Stops agents from creating a fresh ungated base branch (for example f6-gate-retarget-probe).
repository_rulesets._comment: Branch ruleset scoped with ref_name.include refs/heads/** (this repo does not use ~ALL). exclude: main, agent/**, and GOV-0022 human-handle paths refs/heads/<handle>/<type>/** for each handle in GOV_HUMAN_HANDLES (embedded_gate.py / manifest operators.members_expected). dependabot/** is blocked until fabricbloc has dependabot.yml and a ruling re-adds the exemption. No standing bypass — break-glass: set enforcement Disabled (org audit log).

repository_rulesets.name: canon-deploy-branches-human-only
repository_rulesets._finding: Finding (c). release/** and prod/** creation and direct updates are human-only (org admin break-glass).
repository_rulesets._comment: release/** and prod/** creation and direct updates are human-only. No standing bypass — break-glass: set enforcement Disabled (org audit log).

repository_rulesets.name: canon-agent-branches
repository_rulesets._comment: agent/** heads: no force-push, so reviewed history cannot be rewritten. Deletion stays allowed for merged-branch cleanup.

repository_rulesets.name: canon-provider-branches-blocked
repository_rulesets._comment: Blocks creating provider-default prefixes. Not an F6 prerequisite: the pinned gates are default-deny, not branch-name scoped. No bypass.

repository_rulesets.name: canon-autonomous-branch-creation
repository_rulesets._comment: Only fabricbloc-agent-ops (and org admins) may create agent/autonomous/**. HELD while submodule-bump creates these branches with the FABRICBLOC_ACTION_AUTOMATION PAT. Not an F6 prerequisite.

repository_rulesets.name: canon-push-protected-paths
repository_rulesets._finding: F6 layer (b). Rejects pushes to ANY branch that touch workflows, actions, gate scripts, engine, .cursor, .claude/hooks, .gitmodules or CODEOWNERS unless the pusher is an org admin. Stops the Cursor App installation token, fabricbloc-agent-ops and non-admin users. Also closes agent-added workflows that run with repo secrets on push/pull_request, which layer (a) cannot stop.
repository_rulesets._apply_after: README step 8: stage-1 evidence that Cursor pushes as the Cursor App installation, not with an org admin's user token. If it pushes as an admin, the OrganizationAdmin bypass exempts it and this ruleset does nothing against Cursor.

repository_rulesets.name: policy-main-protected
repository_rulesets._finding: F6 root of trust. The policy repo is PUBLIC, and push rulesets exist only for private/internal repos, so main is protected with a branch ruleset. Because the gates are SHA-pinned, even a bad merge here changes nothing until an org owner re-pins canon-agent-gates.
repository_rulesets._apply_after: README step 2 (before the pinned gates land)
repository_rulesets._rules_note: 'update' with OrganizationAdmin (pull_request mode) as the only bypass: only org admins can change main, and only through a PR. No App or non-admin collaborator can.
